sections.heading: What are Taxes?
sections.text: Taxes are compulsory payments made to the government.

sections.heading: Why Taxes Exist
sections.text: They fund infrastructure, public services, and development.

sections.heading: Types of Taxes
sections.text:
Direct: Income tax
Indirect: GST, sales tax

sections.heading: Taxable Income
sections.text: Taxable income = total income – deductions – exemptions

sections.heading: Deductions
sections.text: Investments and expenses that reduce taxable income.

sections.heading: Tax Planning
sections.text: Legally reducing tax through smart financial decisions.

sections.heading: Filing Taxes
sections.text: Submit income details, calculate tax, and file returns.

sections.heading: Importance
sections.text: Helps with loans, compliance, and financial credibility.
